correctness.rationale: The connected closed orientable deleted-product surface has 20 vertices, 60 edges, 30 squares and Euler characteristic -10; signed integer cellular matrices have d1d2=0, ranks 19 and 29 and all 29 nonzero Smith factors equal one; its kernel generator is primitive with all 30 coefficients ±1. Exact fundamental-chain transformations and signed Hopf traces for all 240 group elements establish the stated S5×C2 characters; exterior-square standard character and rational character uniqueness give the graded modules. An orientation-reversing free particle exchange yields the Lagrangian eigenspaces.

value.rationale: K5 is the canonical smallest nonplanar Kuratowski graph and its two-point deleted product is a distinguished closed genus-six surface. A complete S5×C2 irreducible homology character is a motivated symmetry-sensitive invariant not determined by its well-known genus/ranks; the two six-dimensional isotypic particle-exchange eigenspaces are S5-stable Lagrangians and determine the rational first homology of the nonorientable unordered quotient.
